kNN graph by NN-Descent, without an index

Source: R/indices_graph.R
knn_graph_nndescent.Rd

Matrix in, kNN graph out. Runs the same descent as NNDescentIndex, but drops the seeding trees as soon as they are joined and keeps no index, so peak memory stays near the data plus the graph. At the same seed, n_trees and descent parameters, the result is identical to NNDescentIndex$new(...)$extract_knn(). Use NNDescentIndex if you also want to query the graph with new data.

k_graph is the number of neighbours the descent finds per sample, the sample itself not counted. With include_self = TRUE (the default, as for $query_self()) each row starts with the sample itself at distance 0, so the matrices have k_graph + 1 columns. With include_self = FALSE they have k_graph columns of true neighbours only.

Usage

knn_graph_nndescent(
  data,
  metric = c("euclidean", "sqeuclidean", "cosine", "manhattan"),
  k_graph = 15L,
  delta = 0.001,
  max_iter = NULL,
  max_candidates = NULL,
  n_trees = NULL,
  include_self = TRUE,
  return_dist = TRUE,
  seed = 42L,
  precision = c("float", "double"),
  .verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

Numeric matrix or data.frame. Samples x features.

metric

String. One of c("euclidean", "sqeuclidean", "cosine", "manhattan").

k_graph

Integer. Neighbours per sample found by the descent, the sample itself not counted.

delta

Numeric. Convergence threshold: descent stops once the fraction of updated edges falls below it.

max_iter

Integer or NULL. Iteration cap. NULL uses max(round(log2(n)), 5).

max_candidates

Integer or NULL. Neighbours sampled per node per local join. NULL uses min(k_graph, 60).

n_trees

Integer or NULL. Random projection trees for the seed graph. NULL uses min(5 + round(sqrt(n) / 20), 64).

include_self

Boolean. Put each sample first at distance 0, adding one column.

return_dist

Boolean. Return the distances as well.

seed

Integer. Fixes the seed graph and the sampling.

precision

String. "float" runs the descent in f32, "double" in f64.

.verbose

Boolean or integer. Build progress from Rust: 0 or FALSE silent, 1 or TRUE progress, 2 adds timed build stages.

Value

A list with:

  • idx - Integer matrix, samples x (k_graph + include_self), 1-based neighbour indices sorted by distance. Rows the descent could not fill are NA padded.

  • dist - Double matrix of the same shape with the distances, Inf where idx is NA. NULL if return_dist = FALSE.

References

Dong W, Charikar M, Li K (2011). Efficient k-nearest neighbor graph construction for generic similarity measures. Proceedings of the 20th International Conference on World Wide Web, 577-586. doi:10.1145/1963405.1963487

Examples

x <- generate_clustered_data(1000L, 16L)$data
knn <- knn_graph_nndescent(x, k_graph = 15L)
dim(knn$idx)
#> [1] 1000   16
